verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Workable browser extension that captures prospects from LinkedIn or other web pages into the ATS, and no deduplication on capture is described. The pack only covers adjacent features: a passive-candidate search database, AI candidate recommendations, and API endpoints for creating candidates, none of which is the extension capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As a recruiter, a browser extension captures prospects from LinkedIn and the web straight into the ATS with deduplication
